question: True or false: until 2018, a UK broadband advert could quote an up-to speed that only one customer in ten received?
answer: True. Advertising guidance let providers quote speeds available to at least 10% of customers, labelled up to. From May 2018 it asked for speeds that at least half of customers get between 8 and 10pm, labelled average. The big number on the poster had described the lucky tenth.
move: Ask whose experience a headline figure describes: the typical one or the best.
ask: When a product promises up to something, what would someone like me actually get?
trap: Reading up to as a typical speed rather than a best case.
